 Bottle sterilizers recalled after reports of plastic housing melting 
 By Brandy Beard Published : Nov. 6, 2026 at 5:50 PM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google (Gray News) - About 29,000 bottle sterilizers are under recall for burn hazards.
 Baby Brezza announced the recall of its SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer on Nov. 5.
 According to the Consumer Product Safety Commission, the dryers can overheat and pose a burn hazard.
 About 29,000 bottle sterilizers are under recall for burn hazards. (Consumer Product Safety Commission) The dryers are used to sterilize and dry baby bottles and breast pump parts. They were sold nationwide at TJ Maxx, Marshall’s, babybrezza.com, target.com and babylist.com.
 The affected units were sold between Jan. 2024 and Oct. 2026 and include model numbers BRZ0083, BRZ0154 and BRZ0156.
 CPSC said it received 32 reports of the dryers overheating or the plastic housing melting. No injuries were reported.
 Anyone with an affected dryer should contact Baby Brezza for a free replacement.
